title: Illicit Minor
also_known_as: illicit process of the minor term
description: Any form of a *categorical syllogism* in which the minor term is distributed in the conclusion, but not in the minor premise.
logical_form:
All A are B.

All B are C.

Therefore, all C are A.

examples.example:
All Catholics are Christian.

All Christians are Jesus lovers.

Therefore, all Jesus lovers are Catholic.
examples.explanation: In our example, the minor term is “Jesus lovers” because it is the term that appears in the minor premise (second premise) as the predicate and in the conclusion.  As such, in this position, it is “undistributed”.

examples.example:
All Paul Newman movies are great.

All great movies are Oscar winners.

Therefore, all Oscar winners are Paul Newman movies.
examples.explanation: In our example, the minor term is “Oscar winners” because it is the term that appears in the minor premise (second premise) as the predicate and in the conclusion.  As such, in this position, it is “undistributed”.

exceptions:
None.

**Fun Fact:** The Catholic bible has 73 books, the Protestant bible only has 66.
references: Neil, S. (1853). *The Art of Reasoning: A Popular Exposition of the Principles of Logic*. Walton & Maberly.
description_et: *Kategoorilise süllogismi* mis tahes vorm, milles minoorset terminit jaotatakse järelduses, kuid mitte minoorses eelduses.
logical_form_et:
Kõik A on B.

Kõik B on C.

Seetõttu on kõik C A.
exceptions_et:
Mitte ühtegi.

**Lõbus fakt:** Katoliku piiblis on 73 raamatut, protestantlikus piiblis vaid 66.

examples_et.example:
Kõik katoliiklased on kristlased.

Kõik kristlased on Jeesuse armastajad.

Seetõttu on kõik Jeesuse armastajad katoliiklased.
examples_et.explanation: Meie näites on minoorseks terminiks "Jeesusarmastajad", kuna see on termin, mis esineb minoorses eelduses (teises eelduses) predikaadina ja järelduses.  Sellisena on see selles positsioonis "jaotamata".
